summary: The requirement is to implement a feature that allows users to reset their password.

testability.reason: The testability is not applicable in this case as we are dealing with a requirement and nota test scenario.

overall_risk.reason: The risk is low as users can reset their password through this feature.

risks.description: The password reset feature can be exploited if not implemented securely, but it is not a high risk.
There is a performance impact when resetting the password due to the need to update the password database.
Users may experience inconvenience due to the need to enter their current password and enter their new password twice.

assumptions: Users can successfully log in to the system.
clarification_questions: What is the password reset process that will be implemented?
Will the system store the password reset attempts?
What is the maximum number of attempts allowed for a password reset?
Does the system have a password recovery mechanism in place?

test_scenarios.title: User successfully resets their password
test_scenarios.description: A user successfully resets their password without any issues.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: The user should be able to reset their password without encountering any issues.

confidence.reason: The requirement is clear and specific.
